findings.problem: The hint rules out echt, but wahr (der wahre Grund) and tatsächlich (der tatsächliche Grund) are also correct and common for "the real reason", so the prompt has more than one right answer.
findings.fix: hint: before a noun, as in the actual reason behind it; the same word as actually (not wahr, echt or tatsächlich)

back.target: actual, real (the underlying or true one, as opposed to the apparent one)

note: Spanish verdadero before a noun (la verdadera razón) works the same way, so sharing its picture is fine.
